title: Phenomenal selfhood results from a lack of information

statements.text: Phenomenal selfhood results from autoepistemic closure in a self-representing system. It is realized by a lack of information: the contents of self-consciousness are not experienced as the contents of a representational process, but as oneself, living in the world now. It is the phenomenology of a naive-realistic self-misunderstanding.

sources.quote: Phenomenal selfhood results from autoepistemic closure in a self-representing system
It is the phenomenology of a system caught in a naive-realistic self-misunderstanding.
